name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
title: Vikran Engineering Ltd - 544496 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 standalone revenue INR204 cr (+28%) with consolidated revenue only INR141.6 cr after NOPL consolidation; H2-weighted FY27 guide of INR2,300–2,500 cr and receivables (debtor days ~296) remain the key unproven items.

capex.quote: we are putting up the capex so that later on power generated can be sold to the state DISCOM

triggers.label: Debtor days ~296, peak claimed
triggers.quote: I saw that the debtor days is around 296

triggers.label: FY27 revenue INR2,300–2,500 cr
triggers.quote: we are looking at around anywhere from INR2,300 crores to INR2,500 crores of revenue this year

triggers.label: Solar EPC 62% of INR6,496 cr order book
triggers.quote: solar EPC at 62%, followed by Power T&D which is at 28%

triggers.label: Disputed INR29 cr receivable in court
triggers.quote: the INR29 crores, the disputed amount that is currently being reviewed by the court

guidance.quote: we are looking at around anywhere from INR2,300 crores to INR2,500 crores of revenue this year
We are planning to do around INR1,500-odd crores of revenue coming in from this project.
As we are maintaining around 14% to 17% of EBITDA margin, which is consistent from last four years.
we are expecting this in this quarter. The, I mean, we are expecting the disbursement as well.
as I committed by end of this financial year, we will be the cash positive

red_flags.label: Debtor days ~296; Jal Jeevan receivables slow
red_flags.quote: I saw that the debtor days is around 296

red_flags.label: Consolidated revenue dip; NOPL cost booked without revenue
red_flags.quote: any overheads that we are incurring on the NOPL project is also not getting, sorry the cost is again getting booked without the revenue

red_flags.label: Disputed INR29 cr receivable in court; invoked project
red_flags.quote: the INR29 crores, the disputed amount that is currently being reviewed by the court

red_flags.label: Management said 'balance sheet' but meant P&L in clarification
red_flags.quote: The reference to “Balance Sheet” was inadvertent and should be read as “P&L” in the above context.

evasions.quote: So, this confusion is simply because this is the first time the company has published consolidated versus standalone balance sheet.
we are trying to improve our margins in the new orders that we take rather than go for aggressive bidding and take a project at 8%, 9% EBITDA margin

evasions.topic: NOPL funding mix and sanction status
evasions.quote: we are discussing with a few agencies

summary.headline: Vikran Q1 FY27 standalone revenue rose 28.2% YoY to INR204 crore and PAT 209.9% to INR17.5 crore, while consolidated PAT was only INR4 crore.
